title: Memory box design sheet
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 2: Observational drawing and a memory box (Memory Box)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 7 (Memory box design sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 7: Make a memory box (DT). Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

blocks.text: Draw patterns, shapes and objects (no people). Label the colours you will use.

keywords.def: say what is good and what to improve

questions.q: Plan your pattern on the design sheet.
questions.a: A labelled plan with shapes and colours

questions.q: How will you join the paper to the box?
Core: Cover and decorate your box. Join parts firmly.
Extend: Add a label with your name and the year.
Stretch: Say one thing you would improve.
questions.a: For example: smoother paper, a stronger lid
B) Evaluate it. We evaluate: say what went well and what to improve.
Say what is good and what to improve
options: Say what is good and what to improve

questions.q: Big question: what three things would you keep in your box?
questions.a: Three objects with reasons, for example a first Qur'an, a shell, a drawing
